multiplyCents takes Cents | UnroundedCents. A Cents is a bigint, which both send to centsToDecimal. An UnroundedCents is a Decimal, which only @tp/money builds (its brand key is a declared, unexported unique symbol, so no other code writes one without a cast): an ExactDecimal, for which centsToDecimal(amount), that is decimal(amount), returns amount itself. So base is amount either way.
